name: Needs you in the thread
author: wizard
description: With Channels on, a thread shows the amber Needs you line right above the agent's message that asks, with Mark done beside it. Mark done, Reply on that message, or the agent's next status line dropping the ask clears it everywhere; a plain message does not. Brings Mark done to the menus and Reply on any message, retires the Thread tracker strip, and mutes the Archive button (wizard-ux issue 1331).
